summary.text: Brett Fairchild is a Republican state representative from Kansas who has represented District 113 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Brett Fairchild was born in Stafford, Kansas, and earned a degree in business administration from Sterling College.
His career experience includes working as a plan administrator with CPI and as a substitute teacher.
Fairchild took office representing Kansas House District 113 on January 11, 2021, succeeding Alicia Straub.
In the 2025–2026 session he was assigned to the Agriculture Committee, the Higher Education Budget Committee and the Water Committee.
